title: Cerebus Mothers & Daughters #155 Feb 1992 - Aardvark-Vanaheim
descriptionText: This is a single issue comic book featuring Cerebus the Aardvark. The issue number is #155 and it was published by Aardvark-Vanaheim. The comic book is boarded and in English language. It is a US comics tradition and falls under the category of superheroes. The main character is Cerebus and it is uncertified.
